title: Studio designer: two more action/hook hosts ignore the served form rows, so refusals and texts show as raw JSON or not at all
body:
repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As6kDA9BVrMsBR9rmrJ

Filing gate ① · Source: fleet · out-of-scope findings of PR #36688 (Fixes #35650): (a) the #35650 dev's acceptance note (os-dev-report comment 7100034522 on #35650), (b) the L1-b review record on PR #36688 (comment 7103758326, item 5). One family card, as L1-b asked: both are designer hosts that do not hand the served form to the default inspector. Pre-existing; PR #36688 touches neither host.

## What happens
1. **Studio object Hooks view.** `ObjectHooksPanel` mounts `HookDefaultInspector` with `serverSchema` only. `hookForm` declares key-only-record rows for `refusals` and `texts`, but the inspector's "More fields" form gets no form, so both show as raw JSON textareas (`{ "CONTRACT_LOCKED": … }`, `{ "follow_up_subject": … }`). The #35650 card's line "hooks are not affected" holds only for the hook's full-page editor. Rendered on the #36688 branch as the real panel in a test, not in a browser.
2. **Global action from an app nav leaf.** `navSurface.ts` `case 'action'` opens a global action on the Studio canvas; the rail's no-selection `DefaultInspector` branch in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` mounts `ActionDefaultInspector` with neither `serverSchema` nor `serverForm`, so that host draws no "More fields" and neither row in any face. Read on the tree, not run.

## Done when
- Both hosts pass the served form (and schema) so `refusals` and `texts` draw with the key-only-record face and help text, reusing the `serverForm` prop and `servedFormRows` helper PR #36688 adds; one pin per host.
- ⛔ No schema or served-form change.

reach: Studio form (the object Hooks view; a global action opened from an app nav leaf), read from code and a test render; to be measured once by the claimant in a browser.
Business reason: an author editing a script hook's refusal catalogue or texts in Studio gets raw JSON to hand-edit (host 1) or no field at all (host 2), so these declared rows are effectively unauthorable there.
Reader: the o7-studio area of seat repo:objectstack#7 (Studio metadata-admin and studio-design hosts), after PR #36688 lands.
Dedupe: `HookDefaultInspector` in:body → 4, all closed (#29181 #34122 #22187 #11940); `ObjectHooksPanel` in:body → 2, both closed (#29148 #28970); `serverForm` in:body → 0; `"PR #36688"` → #35650 only (the parent card); `navSurface action inspector` → 2, both closed (#26979 #26740).
Suggested-grade: p2 · area:build · Bug · builders, often (the Studio views an author normally uses) · pre-existing, read from code and a test render; same family and grade as #35650.
Blocked-by: #36688 (it adds the `serverForm` prop and `servedFormRows` helper this card reuses)
